typography.display: Newsreader, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif

patterns: Semantic desktop SVG with a record-led mobile sequence

must: Evidence labels, dates, samples and limitations beside claims
Visible rules, tables, folios and purposeful whitespace
WCAG AA-conscious contrast and keyboard-complete interactions
avoid: Gradients, glass, glow and heavy shadows
Stock photography and AI visual cliches

decisions.reason: The open editorial column system supports long-form evidence, premium restraint and mobile reflow. Folio labels, marginal annotations and framed scope tables are retained from Audit Dossier without its rigid document-shell density.

Original inline SVG preserves the Ledger rules and evidence labels at desktop sizes, while a record-led mobile sequence keeps text readable without shrinking the desktop diagram. Motion is sequential, finite, viewport-aware and reduced-motion safe.

The selected direction keeps the original Ledger composition while using smaller headings and tighter sections. Redundant homepage explanation, annotation boxes and the detailed homepage scope table are removed to reduce page length and visual density.

The Measurement & Lead-Source Truth cluster uses one prominent foundational guide, ruled supporting rows, contextual article links and compact code-native frameworks. It preserves the existing Ledger typography and evidence hierarchy while keeping every article discoverable in static HTML.
